description:
Update the properties of mailfolder object.

💡 TIP: Renames a mail folder by updating its displayName. Use list-mail-folders to find the folder ID.

anyOf.description: The number of immediate child mailFolders in the current mailFolder.

childFolders.description: The collection of child folders in the mailFolder.

id.description: The unique identifier for an entity. Read-only.

isHidden.description: Indicates whether the mailFolder is hidden. This property can be set only when creating the folder. Find more information in Hidden mail folders.

messageRules.description: The collection of rules that apply to the user's Inbox folder.

messages.description: The collection of messages in the mailFolder.

multiValueExtendedProperties.description: The collection of multi-value extended properties defined for the mailFolder. Read-only. Nullable.

parentFolderId.description: The unique identifier for the mailFolder's parent mailFolder.

singleValueExtendedProperties.description: The collection of single-value extended properties defined for the mailFolder. Read-only. Nullable.

anyOf.description: The number of items in the mailFolder.
The number of items in the mailFolder marked as unread.

assignCategories.description: A list of categories to be assigned to a message.

copyToFolder.description: The ID of a folder that a message is to be copied to.

delete.description: Indicates whether a message should be moved to the Deleted Items folder.

forwardTo.description: The email addresses of the recipients to which a message should be forwarded.

markAsRead.description: Indicates whether a message should be marked as read.

moveToFolder.description: The ID of the folder that a message will be moved to.

stopProcessingRules.description: Indicates whether subsequent rules should be evaluated.
